# ADR-3212: AWS encryption: Plaintext Secrets Manager put for secret 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

CLI mistakes leave secrets in shell history.

## Decision

Automation SHALL NOT perform a plaintext Secrets Manager put for secret 4 (AWS-encryption-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Prefer API calls from secured runners.
